ck: (5)pavapratipa: nanvatratnana ityanenEva tarnivisesasitO vinatapatakrahanan vyartanityatastatkrtyan vaktunaksipati nanviti anse sitasatanatiti paksEkatese paranatnani paranatnapratiyokikaparanartikapetapavasya sitatvatiti pava paranatnetaratvavisistaniti atnatvaniti vartate tata ca paranatnani paranatnetaratvasyapavena paksatvanapatya noktatosa iti pava satyapaksatavacetakayoriti satyan paranatnapinatvan paksatavacetakan ca tatpinatnatvan tatvirotatityarta prantyeti paranatnetaratvaprakarakaprantirupapratitivisayatvanityarta tata ca satyasya paranartikatvatparanatnetaratvasya prantikalpitatvana virota iti pava atyapaksoktatoseti anse sitasatanatarupatosetyarta yatartanitanaksepastatitanin vakti – paranatnana iti nanyatpaksatavacetakanatra kavesaniyanityevasapta itan ca paranatnanyastiti nanse sitasatanatvan napi virota iti pava kOravanetan paksatavacetakan yuktanityata aha — anyateti atnatvasya paksatavacetakatvense paranatnani patat tatatiriktatvena visesane tasya sitO sitasatanat asitO paksaprasiterityarta kecitu natnatvananse patat napi paranatneratvavisistan tasyatunapyasite napi paranatnetarataya prantya pratiyananatvan paranatnani purvavatanse patatiti pavanahu tacintyan paranatnetarataya prantya pratiyananatvasya paksatavacetakatve paranatnapinatvapratitereva pranatvapatya satyapaksatavacetakayorvirotasyEvapateriti atra hetukrtasyatnatvasya catitve atnatvan nanavyaktinistan catitvatiti prak sankitanunanesitikatanayokatprakarantarenatnatvan nirvaktunaha — atnatvan ceti svaprakasatvaniti avetyatve satyaparoksavyavaharakocatvarupanityarta atnatvasya catirupatvankikare kin patakan yena svaprakasatvan tatityucyata ityata aha — teneti yatyatnatvan cati syat tarhi cateranekanukatatve vacyenekatnavyaktinanankikaryatapatyanekatvasya petavyaptatvena hetusatyayorvirota syat ato catirupan netanatnatvaniti pava hetusatyayorna virota ityupalaksanan prak sankitanunane catitvasyasitikatanavirotopi netyapi krahyan
